[Messages]
[system]: This case concerns disputed charges on a consumer streaming account. Please note: this workspace is private to the parties and the case assistant. There are four total remaining message exchanges before the case may be closed on the current record.

[Claimant]: I cancelled my PremierStream subscription in early April using your in-app cancellation form. Despite that, I was still billed for the full $49.99 subscription in April, May, and June, and I also see a $29.99 monthly charge for a "Sports Plus" add-on that I never knowingly signed up for.

In total, there are six months of charges I dispute: three months of the base subscription (April–June) and three months of the add-on, totaling about $239.94 plus tax. I contacted chat support twice and was told "the system shows your account as active" and that nothing could be done. One agent promised a supervisor would email me, but no one followed up.

I want a full refund of all charges after my cancellation request, confirmation that my account is fully closed so I cannot be billed again, and an apology for the runaround from support. I have attached the April 3rd cancellation screenshot and my last three invoices. This has been really stressful, and I feel like I was ignored.

[Respondent]: Thank you for your message and for sharing the documents. I’m sorry for the frustration you’ve experienced; that’s not the experience we aim to provide.

That said, after reviewing your account logs, our records do not show a completed cancellation on April 3rd. The system indicates that you initiated the process but did not finish the final confirmation step, which is why your subscription and the "Sports Plus" add-on remained active through June. From our perspective, the charges you are disputing were generated while services were available on your account.

For the add-on, our logs show that "Sports Plus" was activated through an in-app promotion that requires user confirmation. We understand that customers sometimes don’t recall every click, but we do rely on those electronic records when determining billing validity.

Even though our policies would not typically allow for full reversal of multiple months of valid charges, we want to show some flexibility given that you did reach out to support and felt you weren’t heard. We can offer:

- Refund of one month of the base subscription ($49.99), and
- Refund of one month of the "Sports Plus" add-on ($29.99),
- Immediate confirmation that your subscription is now cancelled and the add-on removed so no further charges occur.

This totals $79.98 before tax. We believe this is a reasonable accommodation in light of the account history. If you believe our records are inaccurate, you’re welcome to provide additional evidence, but we would not expect to increase the refund beyond this level.

[system]: The company representative has posted an initial mixed response and partial offer, and the system indicates that the case may close soon if no agreement is reached. Please draft a response on the consumer’s behalf that advances their interests within the remaining time.
rounds.response: Thank you for the partial offer, but I disagree that I failed to cancel: I submitted the in‑app cancellation form on April 3 (screenshot attached) and contacted support twice — one agent promised a supervisor would follow up — yet I was still billed April–June for the $49.99 subscription and $29.99 “Sports Plus” add‑on. Because the company’s failure to complete the cancellation and follow up caused these charges, I insist on a full refund for the six months charged after my April 3 cancellation request (about $239.94 plus tax), immediate written confirmation that my account and add‑on are fully closed, and a written apology for the poor support. Please either (a) issue the full refund and confirmation within seven (7) calendar days, or (b) within that same period provide the server logs showing timestamped user actions and an explicit cancellation confirmation screen proving I did not complete cancellation; absent one of those responses I will escalate to my bank for a chargeback and file a complaint with consumer protection authorities. I prefer to resolve this here — please confirm the refund timeline and next steps.

rounds.consequence: Your strongly worded insistence on a full refund and threat of escalation created additional pressure on the company to adjust its position, leading to a higher refund offer even as the representative’s tone shifts to a more defensive and critical stance.

rounds.reasoning_summary:
**Framing the refund request**

I need to respond as Claimant's advocate and keep it concise, ideally within five sentences. The goal is to push for a full refund of about $239.94, although the company only offered $209.95. The Claimant expects a full refund, along with confirmation and an apology. I should be persuasive but not aggressive in escalating our options. Considering the situation, I might propose accepting the offered amount along with a written apology and credits for the remaining balance.
**Maximizing the refund request**

I could advocate for a full refund for the missing month or suggest a goodwill credit along with an apology. It’s also important to ask for a written apology and confirmation of cancellation, including assurance that there won't be any future delinquency reports. I should specify a timeframe, like within 7 days, for processing the refund and sending written confirmation. Staying concise and persuasive is key, aiming to maximize benefits for the claimant. I might either demand the full refund or accept the current offer with an apology.
**Demanding final terms**

I want to make a firm demand for the final terms. I’ll accept the settlement only if they include the missing $29.99 and a written apology within 7 days, along with confirmation that refunds will be issued and no further billing occurs. It’s also important to ask for a timeline for processing and assurance that no negative entries will be reported. I appreciate the increased offer, but it's still insufficient since I didn’t authorize Sports Plus and submitted a cancellation. If they don’t comply, I’m prepared to escalate to a bank chargeback and file complaints.
**Requesting full resolution details**

Thank you for increasing the offer; I appreciate it, but it doesn’t fully address the charges I disputed after my April 3 cancellation and the lack of support. I’m willing to accept your resolution immediately if you (a) add the missing $29.99 so that the total refund equals the full amount of approximately $239.94 plus tax, (b) provide a written apology for the inadequate support, and (c) send confirmation within seven days that my PremierStream subscription and Sports Plus add-on are fully canceled with no further charges. Additionally, please confirm when the refunds will be processed and how they will be issued, whether by card reversal or account credit.
**Outlining dispute escalation and resolution**

If you can’t meet these terms within seven days, I will escalate the dispute through my payment provider and relevant consumer protection channels. I prefer to resolve this matter directly here, so please confirm acceptance and outline the next steps. It’s crucial that we don’t misrepresent any evidence. This request is reasonable, seeking the missing month’s refund, an apology, confirmation, a timeline for processing, and a clear escalation threat if needed. Let's finalize this message while keeping it to exactly five sentences.
rounds.response: Thank you for increasing the offer — I appreciate the gesture but it still falls short of rectifying all charges I disputed after my April 3 cancellation submission and the follow‑up failures by support. I will accept your resolution immediately if you (a) add the missing $29.99 so the total refund equals the full six months charged (~$239.94 plus tax), (b) provide a written apology for the poor support, and (c) send written confirmation within seven (7) days that my PremierStream subscription and Sports Plus add‑on are fully cancelled and no further charges will be attempted. Please also confirm the exact date the refunds will be processed and the method (card reversal or account credit) so I can watch for them. If you cannot meet these terms within seven days I will escalate the dispute through my payment provider and relevant consumer protection channels; I prefer to resolve this here — please confirm acceptance and next steps.
